description: Displays mathematical expressions as inline formulas or separate equations.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code: The identity describes a right triangle.

attributes.name: displaystyle
attributes.description: Uses display-style mathematics in a centered block instead of inline mathematics.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible description of the formula; defaults to its source text.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Input notation: latexmath for LaTeX expressions or asciimath for ASCII math. Invalid values use latexmath.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Expression file; takes precedence over value and inline content.

events.name: tp-math-error
events.description: Emitted when loading or rendering the current expression fails.

events.name: tp-math-rendered
events.description: Emitted after the current expression is rendered successfully.
events.detail: { value: string; mode: TpMathMode; displaystyle: boolean }

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-callout
dependencies.summary: Callout component for highlighted contextual content.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-math>` element displays mathematical expressions as inline formulas or separate equations.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | Read the rendered expression. There are no component-specific buttons or editing controls. |
| Wide display formula | Scroll horizontally when the expression exceeds the available width. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Formula | No component-specific keyboard interaction; the expression is not an editable field. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
